comment: Connected GitHub semantic model with organization, owner, repository and personal-user scopes. User activity includes authored PRs, issues, discussions and issue/PR, discussion and commit comments. Approved counts, active-day/repository measures, UTC calendar dimensions and evidence support explicit period comparisons.

semantic_query.filter: submitted_review_count > 0 AND pull_request_reviews.submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND pull_request_reviews.reviewer_id IS NOT NULL

authored_commit_comment_created_month.expression: CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(authored_commit_comments.created_at AS DATE)) AS DATE)

authored_commit_comment_created_week.expression: CAST(DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(authored_commit_comments.created_at AS DATE)) AS DATE)

authored_discussion_created_month.expression: CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(authored_discussions.created_at AS DATE)) AS DATE)

authored_discussion_created_week.expression: CAST(DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(authored_discussions.created_at AS DATE)) AS DATE)

authored_discussion_title_category.expression: CASE WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_discussions.title), LOWER('docs:')) THEN 'documentation' WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_discussions.title), LOWER('fix:')) THEN 'bugfix' WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_discussions.title), LOWER('feat:')) THEN 'feature' WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_discussions.title), LOWER('refactor:')) THEN 'refactoring' WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_discussions.title), LOWER('test:')) THEN 'testing' ELSE 'unclassified' END

authored_issue_comment_created_month.expression: CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(authored_issue_comments.created_at AS DATE)) AS DATE)

authored_issue_comment_created_week.expression: CAST(DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(authored_issue_comments.created_at AS DATE)) AS DATE)

authored_issue_created_month.expression: CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(authored_issues.created_at AS DATE)) AS DATE)

authored_issue_created_week.expression: CAST(DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(authored_issues.created_at AS DATE)) AS DATE)

authored_issue_title_category.expression: CASE WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_issues.title), LOWER('docs:')) THEN 'documentation' WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_issues.title), LOWER('fix:')) THEN 'bugfix' WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_issues.title), LOWER('feat:')) THEN 'feature' WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_issues.title), LOWER('refactor:')) THEN 'refactoring' WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_issues.title), LOWER('test:')) THEN 'testing' ELSE 'unclassified' END

authored_pr_created_month.expression: CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(authored_pull_requests.created_at AS DATE)) AS DATE)

authored_pr_created_week.expression: CAST(DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(authored_pull_requests.created_at AS DATE)) AS DATE)

authored_pr_title_category.expression: CASE WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_pull_requests.title), LOWER('docs:')) THEN 'documentation' WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_pull_requests.title), LOWER('fix:')) THEN 'bugfix' WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_pull_requests.title), LOWER('feat:')) THEN 'feature' WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_pull_requests.title), LOWER('refactor:')) THEN 'refactoring' WHEN STARTSWITH(LOWER(authored_pull_requests.title), LOWER('test:')) THEN 'testing' ELSE 'unclassified' END

result_columns.name: user
result_columns.type: STRUCT("avatar_url" VARCHAR, "email" VARCHAR, "events_url" VARCHAR, "followers_url" VARCHAR, "following_url" VARCHAR, "gists_url" VARCHAR, "gravatar_id" VARCHAR, "html_url" VARCHAR, "id" BIGINT, "login" VARCHAR, "name" VARCHAR, "node_id" VARCHAR, "organizations_url" VARCHAR, "received_events_url" VARCHAR, "repos_url" VARCHAR, "site_admin" BOOLEAN, "starred_at" VARCHAR, "starred_url" VARCHAR, "subscriptions_url" VARCHAR, "type" VARCHAR, "url" VARCHAR, "user_view_type" VARCHAR)

monthly_user_pr_rank.expression: DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY authored_pull_requests.authored_pr_created_month ORDER BY authored_pr_count DESC)

review_latest_rank.expression: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY submitted_reviews.repository_id, submitted_reviews.pull_request_number, submitted_reviews.reviewer_id ORDER BY submitted_reviews.submitted_at DESC, submitted_reviews.review_id DESC)

name: github

authored_commit_comments.comment: Commit comments authored by the selected user, not commits or code-change counts.

authored_discussion_comments.comment: Discussion comments and replies authored by the selected user. Missing discussion/repository context remains NULL and does not discard an attributable comment.

authored_discussions.comment: Repository discussions started by the selected user across visible repositories.

authored_issue_comments.comment: Issue and PR timeline comments authored by the selected user; these are comment records, not review submissions or distinct issues.

authored_issues.comment: Issues authored by the selected user across visible repositories. Creation activity; current status is not status at a historical period end.

authored_pull_requests.comment: PRs authored by the selected personal user across visible repositories, including repositories the user does not own. Each row's author must match the canonical user or the query fails. This is independent of owned-repository inventory.

organization_memberships.comment: Current organization membership visible to the attached credentials, including concealed members only when authorized. Membership does not imply employment; outside repository contributors are not members.

organizations.comment: Canonical organization profiles for an explicit organization scope; not an inventory of every organization on GitHub.

pull_request_reviews.comment: Review records including pending and dismissed records; reviewer and PR-author roles remain distinct. Not latest reviewer decisions or merge eligibility.

pull_requests.comment: All selected open and closed pull requests, preserving PR grain and author role.

repositories.comment: Canonical visible repository inventory. Organization scopes follow credential visibility; user scopes list PUBLIC owned repositories only.

repository_labels.comment: Current repository label definitions, including unused labels; not issue/PR memberships.

team_memberships.comment: Effective membership returned for each visible team. One person in two teams contributes two memberships. Child-team membership may be included by GitHub; optional role and inherited fields remain NULL when absent.

teams.comment: Teams in the selected organization visible to the attached credentials; includes teams with no returned members.

users.comment: One canonical personal GitHub user profile. User scope does not mean owned repositories; organization logins reject.

authored_issues.authored_issue_created_w.comment: UTC Gregorian week of creation; weeks begin Monday.

authored_pull_requests.authored_pr_merge.comment: Gregorian UTC date of merge for an authored PR; NULL until merged.

authored_pull_requests.authored_pr_title.comment: Transparent classification from case-insensitive conventional title prefixes docs:, fix:, feat:, refactor:, test:. First matching rule wins; other titles are unclassified. This describes title wording, not author intent; original title is available as evidence.

authored_pull_requests.merge_hours.comment: Elapsed UTC milliseconds between creation and merge divided by 3600000; NULL until merged.

first_review_prs.repository_id.comment: One observed row per PR with at least one eligible timestamped review. Unreviewed PRs are absent, not zero-latency observations.

latest_reviewer_reviews.repository_id.comment: Latest observed submitted review per PR/reviewer. Multiple PRs by one reviewer remain separate; this is not merge eligibility.

pull_request_assignees.assignee_id.comment: Account identity of a current PR assignee; distinct from author/reviewer roles.

pull_request_assignees.assignee_login.comment: Current login of a PR assignee.

pull_request_labels.label_id.comment: Stable identity of an assigned repository label.

pull_request_labels.label_name.comment: Current assigned label name; names are not unique across repositories.

pull_request_reviews.pull_request_create.comment: Creation instant of the pull request being reviewed, for approved first-review latency.

pull_request_reviews.review_latency_hour.comment: Elapsed hours from PR creation to this review submission, using UTC instants; pending timestamps remain NULL.

pull_request_reviews.review_submitted_da.comment: Gregorian UTC calendar date of review submission; NULL when GitHub has not supplied a submission timestamp, including pending reviews.

pull_request_reviews.review_submitted_ea.comment: Fixed US Eastern reporting wall clock (America/New_York with DST). Explicit reporting choice; never inferred from a GitHub profile location.
US Eastern reporting date using America/New_York daylight-saving rules. UTC dates remain available separately.

pull_requests.merge_hours.comment: Elapsed UTC milliseconds between creation and merge divided by 3600000; NULL until merged.

pull_requests.pull_request_created_day.comment: Gregorian UTC calendar date of PR creation, independent of the client's local timezone.

pull_requests.pull_request_merged_day.comment: Gregorian UTC calendar date of PR merge; NULL for unmerged PRs. Date filters define a merge cohort, not a creation cohort.

repository_topics.topic.comment: Current topic string; a repository can have multiple topics.

submitted_reviews.repository_id.comment: Timestamped submitted reviews with stable reviewer identity; pending and anonymous records are excluded before ranking.

approved_review_count.comment: Review records currently marked APPROVED. Dismissed approvals do not qualify; this is not distinct approvers or merge eligibility.

assigned_pull_request_count.comment: Current PR-assignee memberships; assignment does not establish authorship, review or team contribution. Distinct parents represented by the selected memberships; excludes parents with no returned memberships. Never sum this count across membership groups.

authored_commit_comment_active_days.comment: Distinct UTC creation dates represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across repositories and other overlapping groups; inactive dates contribute zero.

authored_commit_comment_count.comment: Commit comments authored by the selected user, not commits or code-change counts. Each visible source identity counts once; event time is its creation timestamp.

authored_commit_comment_repository_count.comment: Distinct known repository identities represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across dates/categories; unknown repository context is excluded.

authored_discussion_active_days.comment: Distinct UTC creation dates represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across repositories and other overlapping groups; inactive dates contribute zero.

authored_discussion_comment_active_days.comment: Distinct UTC creation dates represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across repositories and other overlapping groups; inactive dates contribute zero.

authored_discussion_comment_count.comment: Discussion comments and replies authored by the selected user. Missing discussion/repository context remains NULL and does not discard an attributable comment. Each visible source identity counts once; event time is its creation timestamp.

authored_discussion_comment_repository_c.comment: Distinct known repository identities represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across dates/categories; unknown repository context is excluded.

authored_discussion_comment_unknown_repo.comment: Visible discussion comments with unavailable discussion/repository context. Included in comment count, excluded from distinct known repositories.

authored_discussion_count.comment: Repository discussions started by the selected user across visible repositories. Each visible source identity counts once; event time is its creation timestamp.

authored_discussion_repository_count.comment: Distinct known repository identities represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across dates/categories; unknown repository context is excluded.

authored_issue_active_days.comment: Distinct UTC creation dates represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across repositories and other overlapping groups; inactive dates contribute zero.

authored_issue_comment_active_days.comment: Distinct UTC creation dates represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across repositories and other overlapping groups; inactive dates contribute zero.

authored_issue_comment_count.comment: Issue and PR timeline comments authored by the selected user; these are comment records, not review submissions or distinct issues. Each visible source identity counts once; event time is its creation timestamp.

authored_issue_comment_repository_count.comment: Distinct known repository identities represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across dates/categories; unknown repository context is excluded.

authored_issue_count.comment: Issues authored by the selected user across visible repositories. Creation activity; current status is not status at a historical period end. Each visible source identity counts once; event time is its creation timestamp.

authored_issue_repository_count.comment: Distinct known repository identities represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across dates/categories; unknown repository context is excluded.

authored_median_merge_hours.comment: Exact continuous median elapsed UTC hours from creation to merge for visible authored PRs; NULL for an empty merged cohort.

authored_merged_pr_count.comment: Visible PRs authored by the selected user with a non-NULL merge timestamp.

authored_pr_active_days.comment: Distinct UTC creation dates represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across repositories and other overlapping groups; inactive dates contribute zero.

authored_pr_count.comment: All visible open and closed PRs authored by the selected user, regardless of who owns each repository.

authored_pr_repository_count.comment: Distinct known repository identities represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across dates/categories; unknown repository context is excluded.

label_count.comment: Current label definitions, including unused labels; not issue or pull-request label assignments.

labeled_pull_request_count.comment: Current PR-label memberships; different labels may share a name, so use label_id for identity. Distinct parents represented by the selected memberships; excludes parents with no returned memberships. Never sum this count across membership groups.

latest_approved_reviewer_count.comment: PR/reviewer pairs whose latest submitted record is APPROVED; not distinct people across PRs and not GitHub merge eligibility.

latest_reviewer_review_count.comment: PR/reviewer pairs with an observed submitted review; the latest record is selected before this count.

mean_first_review_hours.comment: Equal weight per reviewed PR; averages the first review latency, not all review records. Unreviewed PRs are excluded.

median_first_review_hours.comment: Median first-review latency across reviewed PRs; one observation per PR.

median_merge_hours.comment: Exact continuous median elapsed UTC hours from PR creation to merge. NULL for an empty merged cohort; independent of review multiplicity.

merged_prs.comment: PRs with a merge timestamp, including bots and draft waiting time.

monthly_authored_pr_total.comment: Visible authored PR total for this user and UTC creation month across all repository groups in the selected population.

monthly_repository_pr_share.comment: Repository share of a user's visible authored PRs in a UTC creation month. Denominator is formed before QUALIFY or output LIMIT; no claim about invisible repositories or contribution quality.

monthly_user_pr_rank.comment: Dense rank of selected users by observed authored-PR count in each UTC creation month. Ties share rank; users with no observed PRs are absent. This is activity volume, not performance or impact.

organization_count.comment: Selected organization identities, including organizations with no visible members, teams or repositories.

organization_member_count.comment: Current visible organization-member relationships, one per organization and account. Credential visibility defines the population; not employees or distinct members across organizations.

p90_first_review_hours.comment: Continuous 90th percentile of first-review latency across reviewed PRs; one observation per PR.

pr_first_review_at.comment: Earliest eligible review submission instant. Missing timestamps and pending states are excluded.
pr_first_review_at.population: pull_request_reviews.submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND pull_request_reviews.state IN ('APPROVED', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'COMMENTED', 'DISMISSED')

pr_first_review_hours.comment: Earliest submitted review latency per selected PR group; use first_review_prs for a distribution with one observation per PR.
pr_first_review_hours.population: pull_request_reviews.submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND pull_request_reviews.state IN ('APPROVED', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'COMMENTED', 'DISMISSED')

pull_request_assignee_membership_count.comment: Current PR-assignee memberships; assignment does not establish authorship, review or team contribution. Counts membership pairs; one parent can contribute to several memberships.

pull_request_count.comment: All selected open and closed PR records; each PR counts once regardless of reviews.

pull_request_label_membership_count.comment: Current PR-label memberships; different labels may share a name, so use label_id for identity. Counts membership pairs; one parent can contribute to several memberships.

repositories_with_topic_count.comment: Current repository-topic memberships in the selected repository/owner/organization population. Distinct parents represented by the selected memberships; excludes parents with no returned memberships. Never sum this count across membership groups.

repository_count.comment: Visible repository entities, including repositories with no PRs or labels.

repository_topic_membership_count.comment: Current repository-topic memberships in the selected repository/owner/organization population. Counts membership pairs; one parent can contribute to several memberships.

review_latest_rank.comment: Latest submitted review per PR and reviewer, ordered by instant and then greatest review ID for deterministic timestamp ties.

review_record_count.comment: All returned review records, including pending records; used before the explicit submitted-review stage filter.

review_record_login.comment: Reviewer login at unique review-record grain; the stable numeric reviewer ID controls identity.

review_record_state.comment: Review state at the unique review-record grain; used only to carry its value into the submitted-review stage.

reviewed_pr_count.comment: PRs with at least one submitted, timestamped review. Each PR contributes once regardless of review count.

submitted_review_count.comment: Review records whose current state is APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, COMMENTED or DISMISSED. Pending reviews are excluded; repeated submissions by one reviewer count separately.

submitted_review_state.comment: Submitted state at a unique review ID, retained for latest-review selection.

submitted_reviewer_login.comment: Reviewer login at a unique submitted review ID; not the PR author.

team_count.comment: Current visible team identities in the selected organization, including empty teams.

team_membership_count.comment: Current visible effective team-account pairs, including inherited membership when returned. Additive over teams as memberships, not distinct people or attributable PR activity.

user_count.comment: Selected personal user accounts, including users with no visible authored PRs.

organization.comment: Explicit GitHub organization scope. Mutually exclusive with owner and repository.

owner.comment: GitHub organization or user owner; user listings contain public owned repositories only. Mutually exclusive with repository and organization.

pull_request_number.comment: Optional one-PR scope; requires repository. NULL includes all open and closed PRs.

repositories.comment: Explicit repository cohort as owner/name values. Supply repositories or one of repository, owner and organization; an empty cohort returns zero counts. Names must be unique ignoring case.

repository.comment: One repository as owner/name. Mutually exclusive with owner and organization.

user.comment: One personal GitHub user login, including work in repositories owned by other accounts.

users.comment: Personal-user cohort. Supply users or user; an empty cohort returns zero counts. Each login must be nonempty and unique ignoring case.
